project_type: Rust workspace (cargo), 3 crates: walrus-fmt library (format + reconstruct engine, embeddable, GUI-free), walx CLI, walker egui/eframe GUI viewer/player.
build_system: Cargo workspace with resolver 2. Members: crates/walrus, crates/walx, crates/walker. walker depends on walrus-fmt with features=["export-all"]. MSRV knob is the single [workspace.package] rust-version (currently 1.95, raised by egui 0.36); walrus-fmt inherits via rust-version.workspace = true. Do NOT add a per-package rust-version override. Local toolchain is 1.98.1.
test_framework: Rust built-in test harness (cargo test). A cargo-gate wrapper runs fmt + clippy + build + nextest. egui_kittest 0.36 is the headless GUI test harness (walker dev-dependency); pattern lives in crates/walker/tests/harness.rs.
build_command: cargo build  (whole workspace, builds walker's export-all). cargo build -p walrus-fmt  (no features = the embeddable boundary build).
test_command: cargo test  (whole workspace). Scoped inner loop: cargo test -p walrus-fmt / cargo test -p walker. Single test by name: cargo test <name>.
verification_instructions: TDD mandatory: write the failing test first, run cargo test to see it FAIL (red), implement minimum to pass (green), refactor keeping green -- never skip the red step. Full gate before done: (1) cargo build -p walrus-fmt no-features compiles AND cargo tree -p walrus-fmt links none of pulldown-cmark/scraper/csv/genpdf/docx-rs; (2) cargo build whole workspace compiles; (3) cargo test whole workspace passes; (4) cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings clean (plus --all-features on walrus-fmt); (5) cargo fmt -- --check passes; (6) no .rs file exceeds 400 non-test lines, strict ASCII in .rs, ASCII-only markdown.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None. examples/walrus-story.wal and examples/walrus.wal are committed fixtures (generated by crates/walrus examples), not regenerated by this task.
environment_constraints: cwd for all work MUST be c:\workspace\Walrus\.worktrees\csv-viewer; relative paths otherwise resolve into the parent workspace. cargo run -p walker is a long-running GUI -- never block an automated step on it; launch it manually only for interactive checks. An exact 1.95 toolchain may not be installed; if so run the MSRV gate on the local 1.98.1 and record that caveat. If a pinned crate's real API or MSRV differs from design.md, SURFACE it via send_message warning rather than diverging silently.
contribution_requirements: Steering rules (workspace-level, mandatory): TDD discipline (red before green); walrus-fmt dependency boundary is SACRED and GUI-free (no egui/eframe, no ff-*, no walx/walker types; heavy export deps optional behind export-* features only); FORMAT.md unchanged; every .rs file under 400 non-test lines (richtext.rs is the html/markdown split seam); strict ASCII in .rs and ASCII-only markdown (-- -> <-> <= >=, no em dashes/curly quotes/unicode arrows); no unwrap/expect in walrus-fmt library code (thiserror + crate::Result), walker is a binary (anyhow .context, expect("why") tolerable), tests use expect("why"); illegal states unrepresentable via data-carrying enums; imports grouped std -> external -> crate-local; section separators // === Name === ASCII only.
key_patterns: walrus-fmt error handling: crate::Result<T> = std::result::Result<T, WalrusError> (thiserror, #[non_exhaustive]); add variants to WalrusError in error.rs for new failure modes. ExportFormat is #[non_exhaustive]. manifest().document is DocumentInfo { encoding, mime, name } with public fields. Player exposes set_step_interval (clamps to >=16ms, currently #[allow(dead_code)]) and the loop/stop/wrap state machine (3 existing tests, UNCHANGED). egui 0.36 app uses the eframe logic(ctx)/ui(ui) split and egui::Panel::top/bottom. egui_kittest harness: Harness::new_ui_state(|ui, state| {...}, state), drive via get_by_label(..).click() + run(), assert harness.state() and query_by_label(..); fixed bounded frames, no pixels/frame-counts.
